agr0: Which treatments are recommended for long-lasting pain?
agr1: The UK national health guideline from NICE (2021) recommends supervised group exercise programmes, staying active and psychological approaches such as cognitive behavioural therapy or acceptance and commitment therapy for long-lasting pain that is not explained by another condition. For this kind of pain, it advises against starting new treatment with paracetamol, anti-inflammatory painkillers or opioids.
